method: Own struct-based GLB decoder; identity transforms verified; every actual exported coordinate mapped to freshly reopened source. Original neck field independently recomputed, no maker contribution labels used. Any strictly positive actual chamber increment selects its incident triangle; all three vertices are inside the same original convex chamber disk, hence the full triangle is inside. Zero means exactly zero, no height threshold. Normal support is analytic ray/triangle interval intersection.
precision: Planar hit formula is z0+w1*(z1-z0)+w2*(z2-z0), so an exact exported host triangle remains exactly host. Barycentric membership epsilon1e-12 is dimensionless numerical edge membership only, not height/radius allowance. Positive contribution and convex-disk containment use strict zero and literal radius limits. The20nm guard is inside the new mesh, not an acceptance epsilon.
limitations: Neck analytical kernel and centers retained; retriangulation can change interpolation away from shared vertices. A contribution component is not a detached object. GPU/scene not run.
